description: A question put to THIS reader, answered on the spot: the ask, the context it needs, the answers, and — once given — the outcome in place of them. Reach for <Alert> when the card only informs, and for a plain <Card> when the decision really happens on another screen. Copy: the title is the question put to THIS reader, phrased as a question. The body carries only what the answer needs; anything else belongs behind the record.

props.name: title
props.description: The question, in the words the reader would use to answer it.

props.name: actions
props.description: The answers, as <Button>s. Two is the usual number; three is the limit before the card is really a form.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: What kind of request this is: "Approval", "Access request".

props.name: meta
props.description: Facts the decision needs: who asked, when, how much.

props.name: children
props.description: The context of the request — a Descriptions of fields, a paragraph, an Identity of who is asking.

props.name: resolved
props.description: Once answered, the card states the outcome instead of the actions, so nobody answers twice and nobody wonders whether it went through.

fields.name: tone
fields.description: What the answer was: success for the affirmative one, danger for the refusal, neutral for anything that expired or was withdrawn.

fields.name: text
fields.description: The outcome as a sentence in the past tense: "Approved by you, 10:24".
